additionalInfo.description: SmartHome automation engine. Xu ly: (1) device telemetry → SmartHomeConditionNode (multi-device batch query, fan-out 1 msg/action) → Action Type Router → SmartHomeBulkCommandNode (parallel RPC); (2) asset telemetry bulk_command → SmartHomeBulkCommandNode truc tiep tu app.
Loc msg type. Chi xu ly Post telemetry / Post attributes — 2 loai co the mang telemetry cua device hoac asset.
Phan nhanh: device telemetry → kiem tra automation rules; asset telemetry co bulk_command → xu ly lenh truc tiep tu app.
Lay UUID chinh xac cua device vao metadata.originatorId.
Di nguoc tu Device → Room → Home theo chieu TO. Doc server attribute 'automations' tren Home Asset vao metadata.homeAutomations.

configuration.jsScript:
var a = metadata.homeAutomations;
return a !== null && a !== undefined && a !== '' && a !== '[]' && a !== 'null';

additionalInfo.description: Thoat som neu khong co automation rules.

CUSTOM NODE. Batch query TimeseriesService.findLatest() cho tat ca device IDs trong conditions. Evaluate tung rule. Output: phat ra 1 TB message doc lap (EXECUTE_ACTION) cho MO^I action trong tat ca rules da triggered — dung ctx.enqueueForTellNext() de fan-out song song, khong can loop trong rule chain. Output: Matched / No Match / Failure.
Phan nhanh theo loai action. Ca device_command lan bulk_command deu di qua SmartHomeBulkCommandNode.
Normalize device_command (1 device) va bulk_command (nhieu devices) ve cung format truoc khi vao SmartHomeBulkCommandNode.
CUSTOM NODE. Gui RPC den nhieu devices theo mode: device_list / room / home. Parallel RPC. Output: Success / Partial Success / Failure.
Cho X giay cho action kieu 'delay'. Vi actions da fan-out song song, delay nay chi anh huong action do, khong block actions khac.
Tao alarm kieu SmartHome Notification cho action send_notification. App doc alarm history de hien thi lich su.
Tao log entry sau khi action hoan thanh. Luu vao telemetry key automation_log.
Luu automation_log vao timeseries. TTL = 30 ngay.
Tao log entry khi co loi (tu SmartHomeConditionNode Failure hoac SmartHomeBulkCommandNode Failure).
Luu failure log vao timeseries. TTL = 30 ngay.
Xu ly direct bulk_command tu app (qua Asset telemetry API). Unwrap msg.bulk_command roi di thang toi SmartHomeBulkCommandNode.
